title: Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Awards and the Price Owed Before Surgery
content:
For the pre-service balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Outpatient Surgery booking under Good Faith & Price Estimates, an approved award of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) that covers the scheduled service date changes the package price owed before surgery — the price from which the deposits held are taken off.

**Rule.** When the covering award's tier discount is above zero and below one hundred percent, the package price owed before surgery is the surgical package price reduced by that discount percentage. When the covering award carries no tier discount and has cap left, it is the smaller of the surgical package price and the cap left. In every other case the award does not change the price owed before surgery.

**Terms as the records show them.** The patient's award is the patient's approved financial assistance case, a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the scheduled service date when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted. Its tier discount is the discount percentage of its Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tier; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case. The surgical package price is the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Award covers the date | Tier discount | Cap left | Package price owed before surgery |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | above 0 and below 100 percent | any | surgical package price reduced by the discount |
| yes | 0 | above zero | smaller of the surgical package price and the cap left |
| yes | 0 | none | not changed by the award |
| yes | 100 percent | any | not changed by the award |
| no, or no approved case | any | any | not changed by the award |

## Examples (hypothetical)

- Surgical package price 4000.00, covering award with a 40 percent discount: price owed before surgery 2400.00.
- Covering hardship award with no discount and 1500.00 of cap left: 1500.00. With 9000.00 of cap left: 4000.00.
